name: Tyrande's Vigilance shortens Starfire Shot and cuts pushback (#1154)
contract: Tyrande's Vigilance 680801 (Spell.dbc, family 32) tooltip: "Reduces the cast time of Starfire Shot by $/1000;S1 sec. Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting ranged abilities by $s2%." Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME (10), EffectBasePoints -501 (=-500 ms), EffectSpellClassMask word0 0x800, which matches Starfire Shot ranks 801978 and 804463-804469 and Starfire Barrage 802682 (family 32, word0 0x800; CastingTimeIndex 19 = 2500 ms and 16 = 1500 ms in SpellCastTimes.dbc). Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_NOT_LOSE_CASTING_TIME (9), EffectBasePoints 74 (=+75), mask (0xc00, 0x100024, 0). Native path: SpellInfo::CalcCastTime applies Unit/Player::ApplySpellMod SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME before the haste multiplier, and Spell::Delayed reads SPELLMOD_NOT_LOSE_CASTING_TIME to shrink the pushback delay. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level with no ratings, so cast-speed multipliers are identical and the cast-time difference must be exactly -500. The pushback clause is proved at the modifier level with spell_modifier op 9 on a base of 100 (100 * (1 + 0.75) = 175), because the harness cannot deliver a damaging hit into a cast; Lunar Lance 502340 (word0 0, word1 0x02000000) lies outside both masks and is the negative control. Values read 2026-09-21 from the shipped /srv/coa/server-data/dbc/Spell.dbc.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Starfire Shot rank 8 cast time without the talent
Starfire Shot casts 0.5 sec faster with the talent
Starfire Barrage cast time without the talent
Starfire Barrage casts 0.5 sec faster with the talent
Lunar Lance cast time without the talent

No pushback modifier on Starfire Shot without the talent
